name: localize
description: Full-site/app internationalization — audit translatable surfaces, extract hardcoded strings, wire i18n (next-intl etc.), translate to N locales with brand/ICU/RTL fidelity, then an independent ISO-17100 revision pass (second native reviewer per locale, back-translation + MQM scoring) and key-parity, leak, build, and viewport/RTL verification. NOT for blog article content (use blog-localize) — this is for codebase/marketing-site UI.
